description: This PHP source file defines the SugarWidgetTabs class, which handles the display of subpanel tabs within the SuiteCRM interface. It includes class properties, a constructor, and a display method that utilizes the Smarty template engine to render tabbed navigation for a user's subpanels.

classes.name: SugarWidgetTabs
classes.description: Displays users subpanels in tabs within SuiteCRM, leveraging the Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SugarWidgetTabs object with tabs data, the current tab key, and a JavaScript callback.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the tab interface using a Smarty template and returns the generated HTML.
